data.title: Explore Your Neighborhood Map
data.description: Use the compass rose to discover exciting places all around our neighborhood!

challenges.instruction: What is south of de Young Museum? Tap it on the map.
What is north of Fire Station? Tap it on the map.
What is west of Richmond Library? Tap it on the map.
What is south of California Academy of Sciences? Tap it on the map.
What is west of Fire Station? Tap it on the map.

places.name: California Academy of Sciences
places.blurb: You can walk inside a huge glass bubble filled with live butterflies.

places.name: de Young Museum
places.blurb: You can ride a giant twisting elevator up a tall tower.

places.name: Koret Playground
places.blurb: This playground features a historic, hand-carved wooden carousel with painted animals.

places.name: Richmond Library
places.fullName: Richmond / Senator Milton Marks Branch Library
places.blurb: You can pick out colorful picture books and sit in a cozy corner.

places.name: Fire Station
places.blurb: Real firefighters live here and slide down a shiny pole when racing to help.

places.name: High School
places.blurb: Older kids go here to learn big-kid subjects like art and science.

places.name: Safeway
places.blurb: The shelves are packed tall with yummy snacks and fresh fruit.

places.name: Victorian Area
places.fullName: Stanyan Park Hotel Area (Historic Victorian Neighborhood)
places.blurb: These old houses look like colorful dollhouses stacked right next to each other.

places.name: Kezar Stadium
places.blurb: Fast runners and soccer players practice on the giant green field.
